purpose: One-shot confirmatory training-budget ablations; no sequential epoch extension or hyperparameter search.

common.constant_selection: fixed from 2295 training candidate rows on the 0.01 grid; not reselected on held-out rows
common.reporting_rule: 0.72 is a design reference, not a statistical significance threshold; exact McNemar against the fixed train-selected constant is the primary inferential test
common.schedule_rule: The existing cosine-schedule recipe is retained and its horizon is set by the declared epoch count; initial learning rate and all other optimization settings are unchanged.
common.decision_rule: Report both budgets regardless of outcome. If the longer-budget result changes the qualitative conclusion, the longer-budget result becomes primary and the shorter-budget result remains in the ablation. No further epoch increase is allowed under this preregistration.

rejection_sft_3.data: pka_sft_gen2_rej/train; reuse the frozen 2295-row oracle-best distillation set without rebuilding
rejection_sft_3.trainable: generator LoRA and PkaHead under the original Stage-3 training recipe
rejection_sft_3.selection: final epoch; no held-out checkpoint selection
primary_metrics: all-row direction accuracy versus the fixed constant
exact two-sided McNemar p-value versus the fixed constant
secondary_metrics: paired direction accuracy and exact McNemar test versus gen2-final on rows scored in both models
paired absolute-target-error change and bootstrap interval
rejection_sft_3.evaluation_protocol: unchanged eval_gen.py/rescore_gen.py pipeline used for the 1-epoch SFT result

offline_dpo_4.reference: the same frozen rej1 adapter; explicit tensor equality check at initialization
offline_dpo_4.selection: final epoch; no held-out checkpoint selection
primary_metrics: single-sample direction accuracy and its relation to the 0.72 design reference
exact two-sided McNemar p-value versus the fixed constant
copy rate and its relation to the 0.15 design bound
offline_dpo_4.evaluation_protocol: first candidate from best_of_n.py; do_sample=True, temperature=0.9, top_p=0.95, max_new_tokens=96, seed=0; unchanged from the 2-epoch DPO evaluation
